de1.P2.C13.ly_do: Da chung minh: (SAB) giao (ABCD)=AB; (SAD) giao (SBC)=SE; (SAC) giao (SBD)=SO (khong phai SM); (SOM) giao (SAD)=SP (khong phai SN); tf_ans D,D,S,S khop.

de1.P2.C14.ly_do: Da tinh lai theo dung quy trinh chuan: cos x=-3can10/10 (nen y b sai), sin x=-can10/10 (y c dung theo cach tinh cua loi giai), sin+cos=-2can10/5 (y d sai); tf_ans D,S,D,S khop. LUU Y: gia thiet tan x=1/3 voi pi/2<x<pi la mau thuan (tan phai am o goc phan tu II) - thay nen sua de (doi khoang hoac dau tan); cac dap an tren chi dung theo cach tinh co hoc cua loi giai.

de1.P3.C17.ly_do: Da tinh lai: x_B-x_A=2pi/3 va sin bang nhau cho x_A=pi/6 nen BC=sin(pi/6)=0,5 khop.

de1.P3.C22.ly_do: Da tinh lai: MQ=SA/3=2, PQ=2AB/3=2, MN=AB=3; dien tich hinh thang vuong =(1/2).2.(3+2)=5 khop.
